title: Cherubim and Living Creatures
lead: Winged beings who guard and carry God's presence: the cherubim at Eden's gate (Genesis 3:24) and on the ark (Exodus 25:18–22), the four living creatures of Ezekiel 1, the seraphim of Isaiah 6, and the four creatures around the throne who never stop praising God (Revelation 4:6–8).
